name: versionkeeping
description: Versionkeeping: safe Git checkpoints, conflict resolution, exact-lease publication, provenance-aware worktree cleanup, and history-preserving fork sync.

interface.shortDescription: Safe Git publication and worktree lifecycle.
interface.longDescription: Versionkeeping provides task-only Git checkpoints, intent-aware conflict resolution, deterministic exact-lease publication planning, provenance-aware worktree cleanup, and history-preserving fork sync.
defaultPrompt: Use $versionkeeping:checkpointing-and-publishing-git-work to checkpoint and publish the current Git task safely.
Use $versionkeeping:resolving-merge-conflicts to interpret and resolve this active Git conflict safely.
Use $versionkeeping:using-persistent-git-worktrees to prepare an isolated worktree.
Use $versionkeeping:syncing-forks-with-upstream to sync this fork safely.
